description: NĐ 168 OCR regression sample (VNLRAG-97): 6-page window of the real scan-only nd-168-2024 PDF (1-bit CCITT, no text layer) with the Article/Clause/Point + d/đ label structure manually reviewed from the gold reference. Used to benchmark Tesseract vie (300 vs 600 DPI) on Article/Clause/Point recognition and the d) vs đ) label distinction.
basis: Manual review reference built from backend/tests/fixtures/parser_benchmark/gold/nd-gold.json (reviewed Article/Clause/Point structure incl. point_label d) vs đ) per docs/03 §3.8.5) and the nd-168-2024-fixture.pdf.txt excerpt text.
review_note: The reviewed reference is the excerpt structure (Điều 5/7/9 with Khoản 1-4 etc.) per nd-gold.json; the OCR quality axes measured per page are phrase hit rate (OCR_BENCH_PHRASES), Vietnamese point-label detection (d) vs đ) counts), s/page, peak RSS and bbox coverage. DPI decision kept at 300 unless the 600 DPI measurement changes the first-pass evidence.
